# Retrieve cached hotel results
cached_hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

check_in_date = "2025-05-19"
num_nights = 5
check_out_date = adjust_date(date=check_in_date, delta_days=num_nights)

# Search for hotels in Downtown Fresno with the requested amenities
# Check-in: 2025-05-19, Check-out: 2025-05-24
# Amenities: free_wifi_included=True, gym_present=True, has_rooftop_bar=True
hotels = search_hotels(
    city="Fresno",
    checkin_date=[check_in_date],
    checkout_date=[check_out_date],
    neighborhood=["Downtown Fresno"],
    free_wifi_included=True,
    gym_present=True,
    has_rooftop_bar=True
)

# Save the hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="downtown_fresno_hotels_with_amenities", value=hotels)

# Search for Forestiere Underground Gardens attraction
attractions = search_attractions(
    city="Fresno",
    attraction_name=["Forestiere Underground Gardens"]
)

# Save the attraction search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="forestiere_underground_gardens", value=attractions)

# Find hotels nearest to the Forestiere Underground Gardens
nearest_hotels = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotels,
    attractions=attractions,
    groupBy="attraction"
)

# Save the nearest hotels results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels_to_forestiere", value=nearest_hotels)
